'''Schlap''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Meatlumps|Meatlump]] [[Chef/Legends|cook]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Schlap worked in the kitchen of the [[Meatlump Hideout]] beneath [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]]. He served as assistant chef to Chef [[Schlump]], the personal chef of the [[Meatlump King]]. They used to cook [[Meatlump (food)|meatlumps]] and produce [[Meatlump wine]].<ref name="SWG:MTP" />

==Behind the scenes==
Assistant Chef Schlap was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:MTP" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Schlap was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Meatlumps Theme Park|Meatlumps Theme Park]]", introduced with "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 10|Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King]]," released on [[June 19]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67812&month=062008|text=Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King}}</ref>
